data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for ElevenLabs Agent Platform to build conversational AI applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides real-time bidirectional audio communication powered by WebRTC via LiveKit, allowing developers to build voice-enabled AI applications. It supports text messaging, client-side tools, reactive state management via ChangeNotifier, and a comprehensive callback system for conversation events.
use_when: Building conversational AI voice assistants using the ElevenLabs Agent platform
Needing real-time full-duplex audio streaming with low latency in Flutter
Registering device-side client tools that an AI agent can invoke
avoid_when: You just need basic audio playback or recording without conversational AI agents
You are building a general-purpose WebRTC application without ElevenLabs integration
strengths: Full-duplex audio streaming with low latency via WebRTC and LiveKit
Rich callback and event system for conversation lifecycle and transcripts
Built-in support for client-side tool execution and session overrides
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration such as microphone permissions and minimum SDK versions
Depends on external backend setup for secure private agent token generation
data.setup_notes: Requires adding microphone permissions to iOS Info.plist (and setting platform to 13.0+) and Android AndroidManifest.xml, along with configuring minimum SDK version 21.
